description_en: Modifies the Internet bandwidth of an IPv6 address
name: ModifyIpv6InternetBandwidth

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the IPv6 gateway. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: IPv6网关的地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the IPv6 address.

You must specify either Ipv6AddressId or Ipv6InternetBandwidthId
parameters.help_zh:
IPv6地址的ID。

您必须输入参数Ipv6AddressId和参数Ipv6InternetBandwidthId中的任意一个
parameters.name: ipv6_address_id

parameters.help_en: The Internet bandwidth instance ID of the IPv6 address
parameters.name: ipv6_internet_bandwidth_id

parameters.help_en:
The Internet bandwidth of the IPv6 address. Unit: Mbit/s.

<props="china">

If the billing method is pay-by-data-transfer, the Internet bandwidth value range is 1 to 1000.
If the billing method is pay-by-bandwidth, the Internet bandwidth value range is 1 to 2000.
If the billing method is traditional 95th percentile, the Internet bandwidth value range is 1 to 2000.

</props>

<props="intl">

If the billing method is pay-by-data-transfer, the Internet bandwidth value range is 1 to 1000.
If the billing method is pay-by-bandwidth, the Internet bandwidth value range is 1 to 2000.
</props>
parameters.help_zh:
IPv6地址的公网带宽。单位：Mbps。

<props="china">

计费方式为按使用流量计费时，公网带宽取值范围：1~1000。
计费方式为按带宽计费时，公网带宽取值范围：1~2000。
计费方式为按传统95计费时，公网带宽取值范围：1~2000。

</props>

<props="intl">

计费方式为按使用流量计费时，公网带宽取值范围：1~1000。
计费方式为按带宽计费时，公网带宽取值范围：1~2000。
</props>
parameters.name: bandwidth

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run without creating the IPv4 gateway. The system checks the required parameters, request format, and service limits. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and then sends the request. If the check succeeds, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the IPv4 gateway is created
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会创建IPv4网关。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接创建IPv4网关
parameters.name: dry_run
